stem: On a perpendicular coordinate plane, the straight segment AB has ends A (2, 6) and B (6, 6). Plot the midpoint of AB.
solution: A and B have the same y-coordinate 6, so AB is parallel to the x-axis and the midpoint has y = 6.
The x-coordinate of the midpoint is halfway between 2 and 6: (2 + 6) ÷ 2 = 4.

hints.text: Check the order of the pair: the first number is read along the x-axis, the second along the y-axis.
Notice which coordinate the two ends share; the midpoint keeps that value, and only the other coordinate needs a halfway point.
